Whoa. HEAD is ec370c4, not fc0dd94! And HEAD already contains all my changes except resolver.h formatting. It seems my earlier edits got committed? Did something auto-commit? Wait, this is bizarre.

Actually, I bet what happened: there's some automation (senior-dev harness) that created commits as I edited? Or the `make configure compile` triggered something? No.

Wait, look: `git log --oneline -3` earlier showed fc0dd94 as HEAD, but now HEAD is ec370c4. And `git log --all` showed 99b97c0 as "senior-dev: exact starting tree". So between then and now, new commits appeared. Something in the environment auto-commits? Let me look at git log now.
